403.description:
Identity conflict in step-up authentication.
- `session.identity_conflict:` The user associated with the verified WebAuthn credential does not match the pinned subject in the current step-up interaction.
Passkey sign-in is not available in a pure step-up: the route is not on the step-up route allow-list and fails with `session.step_up.forbidden_route` before the credential is verified.
